name: Compliance & Risk
focus: Spain/EU launch readiness — promoted SKU gate
summary: Material update: pet deodorizing/cleaning gloves are WATCH only as ordinary cleaners. Any antibacterial, disinfectant, antimicrobial or germ-control positioning triggers BLOCK until the biocidal route is verified for Spain/EU. Handheld vacuum sealer remains BLOCK pending exact electrical/battery/food-contact conformity evidence.
blocker: Before any sale: exact SKU/manufacturer/EU responsible-person mapping, GPSR online-offer data, Spain packaging EPR, legal-guarantee notice, and product-specific evidence. Pet cleaning/deodorizing gloves need full formulation/classification and non-biocidal claims unless authorised.

decisions.detail: Simple non-electrical tools are not automatically CE products. GPSR applies. Selling under our own name/trademark may make us manufacturer.
GPSR applies; avoid crash/restraint claims without evidence. Textile composition labelling may apply.
Needs applicable EU conformity documentation, CE basis, technical documentation/DoC, electrical substance/EMC evidence, WEEE responsibilities and GPSR data.
If at least 80% textile fibres by weight, EU fibre-composition labelling applies.
GPSR applies; avoid universal-fit or measured temperature claims without evidence.
No automatic CE route identified for simple non-electrical grooming tools; GPSR traceability/safety, warnings/instructions and own-brand manufacturer-role mapping remain launch gates.

Ordinary cleaning/deodorizing without a biocidal effect can remain outside BPR, but formulation and CLP classification must be checked. If copy claims antibacterial, disinfectant, antimicrobial, germ-killing or control of harmful organisms, BLOCK until BPR/PT3 authorisation and Article 95 supply-chain status are verified.

GPSR and material safety/traceability apply. Do not make BPA-free, leak-proof, food-grade or human-use claims without supplier evidence. If marketed for human drinking too, food-contact rules need a specific compliance check.

Do not promote commercially until exact SKU documents cover applicable CE legislation, RoHS, WEEE, battery obligations if battery-powered, GPSR information and food-contact compliance for included bags/containers.

requirements: GPSR online offer data per SKU: manufacturer; EU responsible person when needed; picture/type/identifier; applicable warnings.
Official EU legal-guarantee notice displayed prominently for online sales from 27 Sep 2026.
Spain: 3-year legal guarantee for new goods and generally 14-day withdrawal for distance sales.
Discounts need the lowest prior price from the previous 30 days.
Non-essential analytics/advertising cookies require prior consent with reject offered at the same level as accept.
Spain packaging producer status/RPP/SRAP must be mapped under the PPWR regime now applying.
Qualifying direct imports up to EUR150 can incur the temporary EUR3-per-item customs duty since 1 Jul 2026.
Pet cleaning/deodorizing gloves: obtain ingredient/formulation data and CLP classification before listing; prohibit antimicrobial/disinfectant/germ-control claims unless the BPR route is verified.
Battery/electrical test products: exact SKU conformity package before promotion; verify WEEE/RoHS/EMC and Batteries Regulation duties as applicable.
Food-contact accessories bundled with vacuum sealers: require applicable Declaration of Compliance/supporting migration evidence for plastic FCMs.

orchestrator: Muda Cero = WATCH; grooming vacuum = BLOCK.
Treat own-brand role mapping and packaging EPR as launch gates.
Include current low-value import duty in direct non-EU fulfilment economics.
Pet deodorizing cleaning gloves stay WATCH only with non-biocidal positioning and verified formulation/CLP status; any antimicrobial/disinfectant claim = BLOCK pending BPR/PT3 verification.
Handheld vacuum sealer stays BLOCK until exact CE/WEEE/RoHS/battery/FCM package is complete.
store_builder: Add GPSR fields per SKU before commerce.
Add official EU harmonised guarantee notice before checkout.
Keep non-essential trackers off until compliant consent UI exists.
Do not render antibacterial/disinfectant/antimicrobial/germ-killing claims for pet cleaning gloves unless Compliance clears the exact SKU and claim set.
Keep handheld vacuum sealer and pet grooming vacuum hidden/noindex/non-purchasable while BLOCK.
launch_qa: FAIL if guarantee notice or required GPSR fields are missing.
FAIL non-EU direct-ship costing that omits current duty treatment.
FAIL pet cleaning gloves if formulation/CLP status is unknown or copy implies a biocidal function without verified authorisation.
FAIL handheld vacuum sealer if exact conformity, WEEE/battery duties or bundled food-contact evidence are missing.
